nom: L'Oréal Revitalift 1.5 % Pure Hyaluronic Acid Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including a dry T-zone or dry patches, report the serum feels hydrating and softens rough or dry areas, though some found the free sample too small to judge lasting effect.
segments.sensitive: Several self-described very or hyper sensitive reviewers report no burning, redness, or breakouts and describe the serum as gentle, though one non-sensitive reviewer had a severe reaction with burning, bumps, and lip swelling and another reports redness within minutes.
segments.combination: One reviewer with hyper sensitive, combination-oily skin reports the serum works well at night but breaks her out when layered with a daytime moisturizer or used alone during the day.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 60s report smoother, firmer-looking skin and reduced fine lines and wrinkles with continued use.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing her skin as sensitive normal reports visible improvement and no flare-ups after using the serum in place of her rosacea prescription for a couple of weeks.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, including several in their 30s to 60s, report smoother skin, plumper look, and reduced fine lines/wrinkles within days to a few weeks; one reviewer explicitly says it did not change her fine lines and wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report increased hydration, softness, and plumpness, often noticed the same day or after a few days of use; one reviewer says it is no better than other hydration methods.
concerns.redness: One reviewer's skin turned beet red within minutes of application and another reports red, watery eyes with use, while a separate reviewer reports the serum helped reduce pre-existing skin redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer used it successfully in place of her rosacea prescription without flare-ups; another reviewer had a reaction with forehead burning and bumps that persisted after stopping use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports reduced discoloration/unevenness alongside fine lines, and another notes visible improvement in uneven skin tone.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports her skin clearing up over several weeks; another with combination-oily skin reports breakouts when used during the day or layered with another moisturizer; most other reviewers report no new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers state the serum absorbs quickly without leaving an oily or greasy feel, even on skin described as oily or with enlarged pores.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky residue after application
Small sample size limits judging results
Layers well under makeup and moisturizer
Risk of burning or bump reaction

extraits.texte: I was so excited for this product and at first it feels nice on the skin. However after using this product for a few days, IT MADE MY FORHEAD BURN AND IT CAUSED BUMPS ON MY SKIN. IT ALSO MADE MY LIPS SWELL LIKE I GOT BAD LIP INJECTIONS. I NEVER have skin reactions and mind you my skin isnt sensitive but this reaction was scary. When I stopped using it the symptoms went away but took a while for the bumpy textured burn on my forhead to go away .

extraits.titre: Plumped skin but caused a lot of redness
extraits.texte: While it made my skin feel soft and smooth it made my skin turn beet red within minutes

I received a small vial of this as a gift with purchase. I have Rosacea and sensitive normal. While using this for a couple weeks, I did not use my Rosacea prescription. It has a very thin consistency. I dropped it directly on my skin and gently massaged in. It did not leave my fingers or face greasy. I assumed I'd react to the hyaluronic acid and have to pitch it but my skin actually looks and feels great. I didn't have any flare ups or acne from it. I plan to purchase this once my current product is used.

I have very sensitive skin and was weary about trying this, however, I fell in LOVE!! This has no smell or weird sticky texture to the product. It's easy to use and it absorbs so well! My face already feels more hydrated and I can tell a significant change in my eye wrinkles after only two weeks.

I find this serum absolutely amazing. I've tried so many others. I have hyper sensitive, combination-oily skin and night creams don't work for me and make me break out instantly, however with this serum my skin is very happy and looks refreshed come the next day. I've tried using during the day with my daytime moisturizer from another brand and it doesn't quite work and made me break out. I also tried using it alone during the day as a substitute for a daytime moisturizer and that didn't work either. I only use at night before going to bed as my night time ritual after cleansing.
This is great for sensitive but acne prone skin! I've been using it for several weeks and have seen my skin clear up quite a bit!

extraits.titre: I look great and feel more beautiful as I age
